comparison_semantics: Both stages were actually displayed at all three pinned views, with a single full native revisit each after first-emission display limitations.

changes.target_change: Reduce painterly botanical density and leafy wall shadows.
changes.observed_change: Tree leaf silhouettes are flatter and dark-outlined with clearer branch gaps; leafy cast shadows are replaced by crisp window geometry.
changes.preserved_advantage: A mature tree still connects a visible large floor pot to the upper/right crop without obscuring copy.

changes.target_change: Strengthen planar furniture and support contacts.
changes.observed_change: Table edge/legs use flatter clay-red surfaces and teal sill planes have crisp boundaries; the large floor pot gains a clear saucer and floor contact.
changes.preserved_advantage: Three differing support heights and plausible pot bases remain visible.

changes.target_change: Protect exact copy, broad prose and practical ledger.
changes.observed_change: All twelve entries remain once with matching normalized transcriptions; some type and ledger positions are slightly larger/shifted but all functional relationships remain. Invitation/body/slogan/market share the left start; ledger sits immediately under the table edge.
changes.preserved_advantage: Long explanation and date/hours/place/access/care/URL stay readable and locally connected.

changes.target_change: Keep lower identity seam and whole support comparison.
changes.observed_change: The lower identity is slightly lower/right but still begins beneath the central sill seam; the descending furniture section and floor-rooted right mass persist.
changes.preserved_advantage: The identity does not interrupt the useful visit route.

residuals.issue: Pot texture and selected leaf-vein marks remain; contour treatment is cleaner and more polished than rough charcoal.
Clay-red remains concentrated in the table edge, legs and pottery rather than a large wall plane; teal provides the larger architectural mass.
